# Source provenance — dev7.4 publication

This tree publishes the previously missing ooRexx Guitar Tab / MIDI Audio integration source.

Lineage retained from the September development series:
- dev5 physical guitar path over Physics guitar mechanics and Rexx-tronics pickup/electrical peers;
- dev6 Standard MIDI File reader and guitar voicer;
- dev7 stateful MIDI drum performer and four-string bass integration;
- dev7.2 Maths v0.14 / Physics dev46.6 rebase;
- dev7.3 peer-object concurrent band renderer;
- dev7.4 standards review.

External music/MIDI fixtures supplied by the user were qualification inputs only and are not redistributed. Package-local synthetic MIDI/parser tests remain in `tests/`.

At GitHub publication on 2026-10-24 the repository peers had advanced to Physics World 0.1-dev50, Maths 0.16 and Rexx-tronics 0.1-dev25. Historical validation evidence remains scoped to its named dependency versions; current-head requalification is open work.
